Enrich `/firma/[nationalId]` with Romanian trade-registry (`onrc`) and Ministry of
Finance financial (`onrc_financials`) data.

nota: File of ciocan/SICAP.ai at commit 6697c8068692872d665d6bc7896ade159eb60e16. The profiler found the repository link on the project site, and the README names SEAP (e-licitatie.ro) as the origin of the data. The repository shows what the code declares at that commit; it does not prove that the deployed service uses it today. The live service was not requested (sicap.ai and its subdomains are in colectare-interzisa.csv). Types of two Elasticsearch indices of company data and the functions that normalise them: onrc (the trade register, one document for each registration: CUI, registration number, name, legal form, address, CAEN codes and activities, representatives, branches, status flags) and onrc_financials (one document for each CUI and year, values in whole lei: turnover, income, expenses, profit and loss, assets, debts, equity, headcount). The design brief of the repository names them „Romanian trade-registry (onrc) and Ministry of Finance financial (onrc_financials) data”. The interface of the representatives declares birth fields; only their names are read, and the file holds no value of a person. The functions below the interfaces are not read.
